items.title: Cut Wheat and Harvest Shears
items.alt: A pair of open metal harvest shears rests beside two cut wheat stems and a small ball of binding twine.
items.description: A pair of open metal harvest shears rests beside two cut wheat stems and a small ball of binding twine. Use the shears and twine in a harvest-tool vocabulary sheet.

items.title: Grain Sample Meter and Wheat
items.alt: A compact black-and-yellow grain-sample meter has a blank display and a wheat-filled metal cup beside its removable cap and a ripe wheat ear.
items.description: A compact black-and-yellow grain-sample meter has a blank display and a wheat-filled metal cup beside its removable cap and a ripe wheat ear. The display is intentionally blank so a personal layout can add its own caption without implying a measured result.

items.title: Wheat Germination in a Petri Dish
items.alt: A clear petri dish holds four separated sprouting wheat kernels on a pale pad, with its lid tilted behind.
items.description: A clear petri dish holds four separated sprouting wheat kernels on a pale pad, with its lid tilted behind. The separated seedlings suit a classroom germination observation page.

items.title: Sowing Wheat Seeds
items.alt: A hand in a complete green gardening sleeve drops wheat kernels into furrows in a soil seed tray beside an open kraft seed envelope.
items.description: A hand in a complete green gardening sleeve drops wheat kernels into furrows in a soil seed tray beside an open kraft seed envelope. The falling kernels show a sowing action for a personal gardening or classroom planting design.

items.title: Combine Harvester and Wheat
items.alt: A red combine harvester with a wide front cutting header stands behind a compact strip of ripe wheat.
items.description: A red combine harvester with a wide front cutting header stands behind a compact strip of ripe wheat. Use the bounded machine and crop strip in a farm-machinery vocabulary activity.

items.title: Wheat Napkin Place Setting
items.alt: A folded cream linen napkin with two golden wheat heads is tied with a pale blue ribbon on a small ceramic plate.
items.description: A folded cream linen napkin with two golden wheat heads is tied with a pale blue ribbon on a small ceramic plate. The tied napkin makes a useful isolated detail for a personal harvest-table layout.
